969-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
728-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
728-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

3257-5231-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5412-7889.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-7889.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5412-7889.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

1263-4871-6798-7316.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-4460-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-4460-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any land you control

2092-4954-7762.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 6 power.
2092-4954-7762.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Overgrowth triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {2}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-7762.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

2104-2963-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Teleportation Circle.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

687-2404-5414-6099.notablePrerequisites: There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
687-2404-5414-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-2404-5414-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

2292-6112-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2292-6112-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Fumulus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

546-4499-4613-7229.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 5 or greater, or you have a creature card in your graveyard with power 5 or greater.
546-4499-4613-7229.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Ambitious Dragonborn. Ambitious Dragonborn enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Ambitious Dragonborn using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

2102-3814-7176.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
2102-3814-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Argothian Elder to gain all creature types.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7159.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7153.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1003-4050-4053-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that has power or toughness 1 or less and that can be cast using one colored mana.
1003-4050-4053-6989.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

147-2438-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

4905-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4905-5220-6273-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

826-2178-4050-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Repeat.

1661-2034-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
1661-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

252-2073-5147--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

654-1231-5231-6644.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {R}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5200-5296-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
5200-5296-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five +1/+1 counters on Workhorse
Activate Workhorse five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.
5200-5296-6602.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

224-225-1772-3756.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-1772-3756.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

560-2835-3967-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2835-3967-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Fecundity triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Repeat.

3043-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Axebane Guardian does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four creatures with defender.
3043-3869-4067.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

2167-4013-5531.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four lands.
You control at least three mana-producing lands, one of which can produce {C}.
2167-4013-5531.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land, adding one mana of any type that land can produce.
Repeat step 1 at least two more times, and more times if desired, ensuring to leave at least one land on the battlefield.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Lumra.
When Lumra enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

2232-2537-2719.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Sakashima of a Thousand Faces onto the battlefield as a copy of Ghalta from your hand.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4050-4556.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pest, adding {1}.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

5088-5252-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {9}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
5088-5252-5259.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {9}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Shigeki's channel ability by paying {4}{G}{G} and discarding it, returning Rude Awakening and Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Shigeki to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {10}{G}{G}{G}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

457-1339-1636-4639.description:
Activate Urza by tapping Unctus, adding {U}.
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Urza to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by tapping itself, adding {U}.
Urza triggers, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1379-2495-4056-4096.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
1379-2495-4056-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Second Wind and returning Tezzeret the Seeker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Tezzeret the Seeker's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on them, untapping Goblin Welder and any other nonland permanent.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Tezzeret the Seeker and returning Second Wind from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Goblin Welder.
Activate Second Wind's last ability by tapping it, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat.

1434-2557-3649-3851-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Etrata.
Etrata does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Each opponent controls at least three nontoken creatures, minus one for each card they own in exile with a hit counter on it.
1434-2557-3649-3851-4772.description:
Declare Etrata as an attacker, attacking an opponent that owns at least two cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Etrata's myriad ability triggers, creating four copies of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Etrata, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the first Etrata ability, causing the opponent dealt damage by it to exile a creature they control with a hit counter on it, and lose the game if they have at least three cards in exile with hit counters on them.
Repeat step 4  for each remaining trigger.

224-1772-3756-4826.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

273-1475-2034.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Shuko attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
273-1475-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Shuko attached, adding {C}{C}.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

2034-3055-5145.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
2034-3055-5145.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars, adding {C}{C}.
Archon of Falling Stars dies, triggering itself and Gift of Immortality.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars trigger, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Archon of Falling Stars.
Repeat.
